input.text:
tok 1.0 "Ticket booking"

pool company "Travel company"
  lane customer "Customer"
    start searching "Customer searches for a ticket"
    task select "Select the route, date and time"
    task provide "Provide personal information and payment details"
    task travel "Complete the journey"
    end done "Journey completed"
  lane system "Booking system"
    task generate "Generate the ticket"
    xor channel "Send by email or SMS?"
    task email "Send the ticket by email"
    task sms "Send the ticket by SMS"
    xor sent
    and split
    task update "Update the seat inventory"
    task remind "Send reminders and check-in instructions"
    and joined

flow searching -> select -> provide -> generate -> channel
flow channel -> email "email"
flow channel -> sms "SMS"
flow email -> sent
flow sms -> sent
flow sent -> split
flow split -> update
flow split -> remind
flow update -> joined
flow remind -> joined
flow joined -> travel -> done
